title: Deflect the Guard
setup: Black has just brought a rook back to f8 to hold f7, and the knight on h6 is hanging.
hint: The rook on f8 is the only thing guarding f7 — where could you make it stand instead?
explanation:
## The Idea

The knight already covers g8, so {{Qg8+}} cannot be met by the king, and {{Rxg8}} is the only legal reply. The rook that was guarding f7 is now plugging the king's last exit, and {{Nf7#}} finishes. The sacrifice deflects and smothers in one move.
